title: The HKAGE Programme Showcase Day - From AI Robotic Arms to Star Charts Spark a Unique Learning Journey
description: HONG KONG, Aug. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- While many students are still making their final preparations for the new school year, more than 350 student members of the Hong Kong Academy for Gifted Education (HKAGE, or the Academy) have already embarked on a distinctive start to their learning year. The Academy held three sessions of 'Programme Showcase Day 2026' on 28 and 29 August, offering a diverse range of programme experiences that allowed student members to explore the Academy's various gifted education courses for the coming year - covering areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), astronomy, environmental science, forensic science, art, and creative writing - thereby embarking on a new year of gifted learning.
